scope: Prospective final attention source resource/latency validation; exact score arithmetic and new narrow primitive sum. No whole-model release qualification.
controls: Independent primitive implementation with pinned eight-lane floating fold and exact integer PTQ groups; same classes and JVM per pair
timerPolicy: Each of five blocks runs full batches until 250 ms; counts and elapsed duration retained. Batch sizes contain complete 31-input or 255-input mutation cycles. No block discarded.
order: Alternate candidate/baseline order each pair. Fixedcounts on every admittedhost; no outcome stop or adaptive extension. ARM and softmax evidence independently reported; powersize coversx86score.

sampleRationale.hostUncertainty: At least four matched hosts required; hierarchical paired bootstrap resamples hosts then pairs, no assumption512independenthosts. Counts fixed before timing; insufficient hosts/precision remains unresolved.

gates.warmAllocation: Median per-process bytes must not increase; all block allocations also retained and reported. This diagnostic does not replace permanent mixed-caller guard or whole-model resource gates.
